notes.title: Update Notice (Version 1.0.3)
notes.content:
Update Notice (Version 1.0.3)

Thank you for playing.
We have made the following adjustments & fixes.

Version 1.0.3

Added an assumed character difficulty level on the character selection screen.
Added an Initial Deck button on the character selection screen.
You can check the cards in the initial deck.
Fixed a bug that the cumulative score was not added on the result screen.

notes.title: Update Notice (Version 1.0.2)
notes.content:
Thank you for playing.
We have made the following adjustments & fixes.

Version 1.0.2

Fixed the game to start in English when the language is set to English.
The game will start in English when the setting is other than Japanese.
If the language is Japanese, the game will start in Japanese.
Adjusted line breaks and content of the English language text.
Tutorial wording has been adjusted.
Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: Update Notice (Version 1.0.1)
notes.content:
Thank you for playing as always.

■ Version 1.0.1

Adjusted the wording in the tutorial.
Tweaked card descriptions.
When placing a card with a target, it will now prioritize the target card even if multiple cards are overlapped.
If there are multiple overlapping cards, the first one overlapped will be prioritized.
Added a notification when attempting to place a card with a target and there is no target card.
Added a notification when trying to place a card that cannot be placed due to overlapping with other cards.
Added a notification when trying to place a blank card.
